svg.title: SageMaker Project model build architecture
svg.desc: A data scientist pushes to the main branch of the model build CodeCommit repository. An EventBridge rule starts the model build CodePipeline pipeline. Its Build stage runs pipeline.py in CodeBuild, which upserts and starts the SageMaker pipeline: preprocess, train, evaluate, and register on ml.r5.xlarge with a warm pool. The register step adds a model version with the status PendingManualApproval to the project model package group, and every step logs to the MLflow app. Approving a version starts the deployment pipeline.
svg.text: upserts the SageMaker pipeline with the project
role, MLflow app, image, and model package group,
